# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.7 Owner-Decision Parity

Canonical count: nine stable identities, `SCI-MAP-OD-001`--`009`; eight are
`OPEN`; `SCI-MAP-OD-008` is `RESOLVED`.

OD-008 authorizes only `SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1`: lower-inclusive,
upper-exclusive cells; unity on the unique finite in-grid containing pixel;
zero elsewhere; outer-upper-boundary and out-of-grid loss; no wrap or clamp;
fractional projection deferred. This same disposition appears in the owner
ledger, rationale, formal contract, ECS, crosswalk, README, and r0.7 closure
records. No r0.7 artifact uses OD-008's former interim disposition or says
that all nine decisions are open.

The r0.7 owner dispositions on gate ownership/order, one exact MAP operator,
response terminology/domains, and original-footprint coordinates are recorded
as `SCI-MAP-R07-D001`--`D004` without appending or renumbering any
`SCI-MAP-OD` identity. The generated owner register is derived from the same
ledger used by all three views.
